Register a profile and create its empty state directory

Usage: larp cc profile add [OPTIONS] --provider <PROVIDER> <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>  Profile name: 1-32 characters from a-z, 0-9, '-', '_', starting with a letter

Options:
      --json
          Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --provider <PROVIDER>
          Provider this profile is for [possible values: claude, codex]
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>
          Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help
          Print help
